messages.content: List all international airports currently accessible for travel.
I'll help you list all available international airports. Let me retrieve that information for you.

Here are all the international airports currently accessible for travel:

**North America:**
- SFO - San Francisco International Airport
- LAX - Los Angeles International Airport  
- JFK - John F. Kennedy International Airport (New York)
- ORD - O'Hare International Airport (Chicago)
- BOS - Boston Logan International Airport

**Europe:**
- CDG - Charles de Gaulle Airport (Paris)
- LHR - Heathrow Airport (London)
- CIA - Ciampino Airport (Rome)

**Asia:**
- PEK - Beijing Capital International Airport
- HND - Haneda Airport (Tokyo)
- HKG - Hong Kong International Airport

**Other locations:**
- RMS - Rivermist Airport
- SBK - Stonebrook Airport
- MPC - Maplecrest Airport
- SVP - Silverpine Airport
- SHD - Shadowridge Airport
- SSV - Sunset Valley Airport
- OKD - Oakendale Airport
- WLB - Willowbend Airport
- CRH - Crescent Hollow Airport
- ATV - Autumnville Airport
- PHV - Pinehaven Airport
- GFD - Greenfield Airport

These are all the international airports currently available for booking flights through the travel system.
I'm based in Crescent Hollow. Determine which airport is closest to my location from the previously listed options.
I'll help you find the closest airport to Crescent Hollow. Let me check the nearest airport for you.

Based on the information, the closest airport to your location in Crescent Hollow is **CRH (Crescent Hollow Airport)** itself. This is the airport that serves your local area, making it the most convenient option for your travel needs.
I'm organizing a trip soon and need the flight cost from my nearest airport to Pinehaven on March 3, 2026, traveling in business class.
I'll help you get the flight cost from Crescent Hollow Airport (CRH) to Pinehaven Airport (PHV) for March 3, 2026 in business class.

lastModifiedAfter.description: Use this field if you only want Fiscal Years that were changed after the supplied date. The supplied date will be interpreted in the UTC time zone. includeRemoved.description: If true, the service will return all Fiscal Years, including those that were previously removed. If not supplied, this field defaults to false.
